Harper Terradissia is a Harper guarding the entrance to the Last Light Inn in Act Two. She is positioned atop the guard tower by the entry bridge.
“
From up here, you can almost pretend Isobel's light is the sun.
„
— Terradissia

Involvement

Act Two

Last Light Inn

Terradissia guards the entrance to Last Light Inn atop a guard tower above  Darragh and  Elifer.

If  Marcus rescues the party but is exposed as a True Soul, Terradissia is  Stunned and joins the fight against his summoned  Crawling Claws.

Resolve the Abduction

When Marcus attacks the inn and attempts to kidnap  Isobel during ⁠Resolve the Abduction, Terradissia frequently is amongst the Harpers who avoid being  Impaled; she then either runs up to fight the  Winged Horrors, or stays out of combat range. If Isobel is not saved, Terradissia and everyone save for  Jaheira in Last Light Inn turns into  Shadow-Cursed Undead.

Assault Moonrise Towers

If Isobel is saved at the Last Light Inn and the  Nightsong is freed from her cage and heads for Moonrise Towers, Terradissia follows Jaheira to the assault on Moonrise. However, Terradissia is killed during the fight against Absolute forces before the party arrive. Her corpse is in the Moonrise Towers Prison, surrounded by a  Death Shepherd and a horde of  Necromites.
